description: Without a state, the open space roles and employers of every US state. Given a state, its roles by kind of work, the salaries they post, the cities and employers with the most roles and its newest roles. Given a state and a kind of work, the same for that work there (propulsion roles in Texas, say).

kind.description: With a state: one kind of work, one of: 'propulsion' (Propulsion), 'mechanical-structures' (Mechanical), 'avionics-electrical' (Avionics), 'rf-communications' (RF & Payloads), 'gnc-flight-software' (Flight Software), 'ground-software' (Software & IT), 'systems-test' (Systems & Test), 'manufacturing' (Technicians), 'launch-mission-ops' (Launch & Ops), 'quality-safety' (Quality), 'science-imaging' (Science & Data), 'supply-chain-facilities' (Supply Chain), 'business-programs' (Programs & Business), 'ai-training' (AI training).

limit.description: How many of a state's newest roles to return (1 to 25).

state.description: A US state: its two-letter code (e.g. 'TX', 'NY') or its name ('Texas').

name: get_space_jobs_by_state
title: Space industry jobs by state
